gw_in_l2tp.plain_warning: L2TP without IPsec is on: these connections aren’t encrypted — use it only for routers that can’t do IPsec.
gw_in_l2tp.off_both: L2TP accepts no connections: both IPsec and unencrypted L2TP are off (inbounds.l2tp.ipsec / plain).
gw_in_l2tp.err.off: The L2TP protocol is off or accepts no connections (neither IPsec nor unencrypted L2TP).
gw_in_l2tp.err.no_psk: The L2TP/IPsec pre-shared key isn’t created yet: kaskadctl gw apply.
gw_in_l2tp.apple_ipsec_off: Apple’s built-in client supports only L2TP/IPsec, and IPsec is off on the server.
gw_in_l2tp.type_psk_or_plain: L2TP/IPsec with pre-shared key (or L2TP without IPsec)
gw_in_l2tp.err809: Error 809 behind NAT: restart the computer — the script has already set AssumeUDPEncapsulationContextOnSendRule=2.
